items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 10 at 8:51AM AKST until November 10 at 12:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Annette Island, Ketchikan Gateway Borough, and Prince of
Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until noon AKST today.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A series of fronts will move across the area
through Wednesday. Winds slowly subside through late Tuesday
afternoon before another front moves over the area Tues
items.areas: Prince of Wales Island; Ketchikan Gateway Borough; Annette Island
items.instruction:

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 10 at 8:49AM AKST until November 10 at 11:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Freezing rain and heavy rain on snow covered surfaces.

* WHERE...Interior Kenai Peninsula and Turnagain Pass.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM AKST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult due to hydroplaning and
slush on roadways. Gusty winds could bring down tree branches.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 10 at 8:49AM AKST until November 10 at 11:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

across parts of the Matanuska Valley.

* WHERE...Anchorage and Lower Matanuska Valley.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM AKST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Across the Matanuska Valley,
gusty winds could bring down a few tree branches. Some roads and
bridges will likely become slick and hazardous, especially in wind
sheltered areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS
items.instruction:
